key_insight: DeepDOSReasoner predicts electronic and phonon density-of-states spectra from atomic structures while enforcing nonnegativity and total-state conservation.
engineering_relevance: Millisecond spectral predictions could accelerate materials screening, including photovoltaic chalcogenides, but do not directly establish solar-cell performance.
method: Map atomic structures to spectra using atom-to-energy source attention.
Refine normalized spectra through learned continuity-equation transport.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports best accuracy across all evaluated metrics for both spectrum types and new DFT validation of an 8,106-material screen, with 25 of the top 50 candidates confirmed to have valence-band gaps.
watch_item: Valence-band-gap discovery is not a direct measure of photovoltaic efficiency; device-relevant properties and experimental validation remain necessary.
paper_title: DeepDOSReasoner: Physics-Grounded Reasoning for Density-of-States Prediction and Materials Discovery
